title: Bind a named R2DBC parameter immediately inside SQL array brackets
summary: PostgreSQL returned the bound array for tight brackets and preserved the order and multiplicity of [7,2,7]. The parent required a space after the parameter name.

change.description: The R2DBC named-parameter parser treats each square bracket as a separator. The closing bracket remains part of the SQL array expression.

notes: Each history subscribed through Spring DatabaseClient against PostgreSQL 17 and compared the driver's Integer[] with an independently executed literal array.
